summary: Paper W4390437658 (RLPlanner) describes a reinforcement learning-based chiplet floorplanning optimization using PPO with RND exploration and a fast thermal model approximating HotSpot. The scenario references a Multi-GPU System benchmark [4] from TABLE I reporting maximum temperature 91.15 °C (RLPlanner) versus 91.68 °C (TAP-2.5D baseline), with 20.28% average improvement across eight benchmarks. The experiment kind is declared as custom_2d_steady but lacks required inputs: floorplan geometry (empty block list), chiplet power distribution (empty power_w object), individual chiplet dimensions (x_m, y_m, width_m, height_m), boundary conditions, and complete hyperparameters (λ, µ, T0, α). The fast thermal model validation (TABLE II) shows MAE 0.2523 K and 127× speedup versus HotSpot, but external reference [4] defining the Multi-GPU System benchmark is not provided in the packet. All 26 evidence items lack valid page pinning or asset locators, preventing independent verification. The deterministic gate failed on input validation: no blocks and no power_w dictionary supplied. Feasibility verdict is illustrative_2d_only; Studio simulation is blocked.
